pico_duplicate_policy: For duplicate rows at the same voltage and requested timing threshold, choose the run with minimum nominal CTR_ps, then bootstrap that run.
outlier_bootstrap_policy: 4-sigma robust MAD rejection is applied exactly once to the final selected event cohort; bootstrap resamples only from retained events.
bootstrap_error_definition: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of successful bootstrap CTR fits
plotted_central_value: mean of successful bootstrap CTR fits
